description: Compare two ghost-qa JSON reports (the objects returned by ghost_qa_audit_url, or report.json files written by the CLI) and return the Regression & Verification Delta Report: scoreDelta, fixedFindings, newRegressions and remainingFindings. Use it after fixing bugs to prove the fix worked without introducing regressions; verified=true only at score >= 95 with zero regressions and no blocking findings left.

after.description: New ghost-qa report JSON (after fixes), e.g. the saved after.json object

before.description: Baseline ghost-qa report JSON (before fixes), e.g. the saved before.json object

name: ghost_qa_compare
